badge.rule_summary_zh: 票數加總：≥+2 偏牛；≤−2 偏熊；其餘過渡。訊號：2s10s、ISM PMI、失業救濟、HY OAS、標普500。

site_risk.label_zh: 本站規則評估 · 衰退／急挫風險
site_risk.formula_zh: 各訊號票等權：+1→0%、0→50%、−1→100%，再平均；等價式 risk = 100×(票數−得分)/(2×票數)，再夾喺 5–95。透明規則，非 ML、非 NY Fed 模型。
site_risk.formula_en: Equal-weight: +1→0%, 0→50%, −1→100%, then average; equiv. 100*(n-score)/(2*n), clamped to [5,95]. Not ML.
site_risk.note_zh: 由本頁同一套領先指標投票映射而成，唔係概率校準、未做歷史股災回測，唔係投資建議。
site_risk.note_en: Mapped from the same on-page votes — not a calibrated probability. Not investment advice.

crash_comparisons.title_zh: 而家 vs 大股災／衰退前
crash_comparisons.title_en: Now vs levels before major crashes / recessions
crash_comparisons.methodology_zh: NY Fed：同一套公開 probit（α=−0.5333、β=−0.6330，樣本 1959-01–2009-12）套落 FRED T10Y3M 月均，計 12 個月前瞻衰退概率；「而家」優先用官方 PDF 圖表。Chauvet–Piger：FRED RECPROUSM156N 平滑「而家是否衰退」概率（會修訂）。錨點取目標月或之前最近一個月。數值唔會虛構。本站規則評估% 並非歷史校準／回測股災概率，故唔放入呢張對照表。
crash_comparisons.methodology_en: NY Fed: published α/β on FRED T10Y3M monthly averages (12m-ahead); Now prefers official PDF. Chauvet–Piger: FRED RECPROUSM156N (nowcast; revises). Nearest month on/before each anchor. No invented numbers. Site rule risk % is not historically calibrated — omitted from this table.
crash_comparisons.site_risk_note_zh: 本站規則評估而家 20.0% 係領先指標投票映射，唔係概率校準、未做股災回測，所以對照表只放 NY Fed / Chauvet–Piger 公開模型。
crash_comparisons.site_risk_note_en: Site rule risk is a transparent vote mapping — not a calibrated probability and not backtested to crashes. Crash history table covers published models only.
